desc: 单色圆盒腮红，粉质细腻服帖，轻扫即得自然红润妆感
name: 自然红润服帖单色腮红款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底主图
一秒传达红润气色的核心利益，主图一秒法则
放大面色暗沉无气的日常痛点，引出腮红带来的红润改观
代入真实上妆时刻，让买家想象轻扫后红润的自己
用微距粉质肌理证明细腻服帖的粉感
一眼看全色号选择，让买家挑到自己的那支红
收口促单，用行动按钮把种草情绪转化为下单动作

style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots and variant rows, sakura blush pink #F6D7DA for benefit and infographic screens, warm off-white #FAF2EF for scenes

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm rosy color-cosmetics visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, sakura blush pink #F6D7DA, rose-red accent #D6455E and charcoal text #33383D; bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key and gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style with rounded pill callouts; clean high-end color-cosmetics photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for the open round compact across the set
